verdict.headline: Hands-on-keyboard intrusion culminating in domain-credential theft, Finance-data exfiltration, and anti-recovery sabotage on ACCT-WS-007 (10.9.40.27, user adam.hartley), northwind.com

narrative.summary: CONFIRMED MALICIOUS — hands-on-keyboard intrusion culminating in domain-credential theft, Finance-data exfiltration, and anti-recovery sabotage on ACCT-WS-007 (10.9.40.27, user adam.hartley), northwind.com. The vssadmin "delete shadows /all /quiet" EDR alert (2026-09-02T14:02:11Z) is the tail end of a full kill chain, not an isolated event.

explanations.claim: Ransomware/hands-on-keyboard intrusion on ACCT-WS-007: vssadmin deleted shadow copies (T1490) as an anti-recovery step, spawned from a masqueraded parent svchost-helper.dll, indicating attacker code execution.
Benign administrative activity: vssadmin shadow deletion was run by legitimate IT/admin maintenance on ACCT-WS-007.

evidence.claim: Full kill chain on ACCT-WS-007: malicious xlsm -> hidden encoded powershell -> rundll32 svchost-helper.dll implant -> comsvcs LSASS dump -> 7z archive of FS-07 Finance share -> vssadmin+wbadmin anti-recovery.
vssadmin's parent is svchost-helper.dll implant and sits in a malware chain, not legitimate admin maintenance.
Data exfiltration: ACCT-WS-007 sent ~4.8GB over SSL to external 203.0.113.66:443 at 13:11, minutes after 7z archiving of the FS-07 Finance share.

timeline.text: Phishing email from spoofed typosquat billing@nvoicehub-support.com (SPF fail / DKIM none / DMARC fail, src 198.51.100.23) delivered Invoice_40517.xlsm to adam.hartley.
Beaconing to 198.51.100.77:443 began at regular short intervals.
DC01 logged EventCode 4662 DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All by adam.hartley.
ACCT-WS-007 sent ~4.83 GB over SSL to 203.0.113.66:443.

next_steps.text: CONTAIN now: network-isolate ACCT-WS-007 (10.9.40.27) via EDR; do not power off (preserve lsass.dmp, fin.7z, svchost-helper.dll for forensics).
Treat the domain as compromised due to DCSync on DC01: force a domain-wide password reset, reset the krbtgt account password TWICE, and rotate all privileged/service account credentials.

gaps.text: Full scope of data in the 4.83 GB exfil archive beyond \\FS-07\Finance$\* is not itemized.

steps.text: Confirmed the vssadmin event on ACCT-WS-007, user adam.hartley, with a suspicious parent process: svchost-helper.dll. Let me trace the process tree on ACCT-WS-007.
CONFIRMED MALICIOUS — hands-on-keyboard intrusion on ACCT-WS-007.
